messages:
eli_sales: RFI from Poseidon Health just landed. They want an embeddings throughput table, static egress IPs for allowlisting, and a capability matrix comparing Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Deadline COB Tuesday.
tanya_se: I'll draft the throughput table. Do we have recommended batch sizes for 100 qps sustained?
hiro_eng: For 100 qps target, recommend client batch_size=16, kv_cache enabled. With Dedicated and medium model quantized to int8 we can sustain 100 qps with median latency ~60ms.
eli_sales: They want static IPs to add to their firewall. Can we provide per-region CIDRs for Dedicated?
hiro_eng: Yes — we publish stable egress CIDR ranges for Dedicated endpoints per region. For Private (customer VPC) egress is controlled by their infra; we'll provide expected agent outbound ranges and guidance to pin models locally to avoid S3 fetches.
frank_sec: Security bullets for the RFI: TLS1.2+, optional mTLS for Private, customer-managed KMS and BYO-HSM supported, SOC2 Type II and ISO27001 compliance, configurable retention and delete controls. Also note we can provide a pen-test window on request.
tanya_se: Draft rates: Hosted embeddings (small): $0.00038/embedding; Hosted gen: $0.0011/1k tokens. Dedicated pricing = reserved monthly + discounted unit rates; Private = enterprise license. I'll attach a compact matrix and a short POC config row.
filebot: filebot: Attachment uploaded: poseidon_capmatrix_v1.xlsx (link: https://files.redwood/repo/ids/554433) :paperclip:
eli_sales: Great — I'll assemble the RFI package (throughput table + egress guidance + security bullets + matrix) and loop in Legal for a quick review. Thanks everyone.
